nodes.title: One shot + a thought
nodes.hook: The best part was never in the plan.
nodes.visual: One original uninterrupted scene with one short, high-contrast line.
nodes.audio: Natural sound or appropriately licensed music.
nodes.overlay: The best part was never in the plan.
nodes.hypothesis: A single clear idea over strong footage can earn more saves than a busy montage.

nodes.title: Show it working
nodes.hook: Here's the whole thing in ten seconds.
nodes.visual: Real screen recording of the key step, then the result.
nodes.overlay: Here's the whole thing in ten seconds.
nodes.hypothesis: A clear demonstration beats a vague promise.

nodes.title: Say what everyone is thinking
nodes.hook: Be honest, how many tabs do you have open?
nodes.visual: Quick relatable setup, then a real fix.
nodes.overlay: Be honest, how many tabs do you have open?

taglines: Less busywork, more of what matters
strategy: Sell the feeling on the page. Show the proof in the ad. Make the contrast memorable on TikTok.
These channel roles are hypotheses. Test the same idea in more than one format.
One variable per test: hold the idea steady, change the opening or format. Judge business outcomes, not views alone.
